newsitem.title: USA: Barney's Inc names John Brincko president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Barney's Inc names John Brincko president, COO.

text.p: Barney's Inc said Thursday it named John Brincko president and chief operating officer.

The company said in a statement Brincko would report to the executive committee of the company, which consists of Gene and Robert Pressman, co-chairmen and co-chief executive officers of Barney's; Phyllis Pressman, chairperson of the executive committee; and Brincko himself.
The company also said Charles Bunstine II agreed to serve as a consultant to the executive committee.
